brief.intent: Qualify bounded numeric pose and mesh authoring transport without an artistic correction candidate.
brief.audience_result: No premature review: only evidence-backed output can advance; known rejected media stays internal.
brief.strategy: Validated fixed handler plus two fresh processes and a failed-review negative control.
brief.early_proof: No-edit selected native state and dependency preservation.
brief.exclusions: New animation/costume/character work, AV approval, cloud, spend and arbitrary scripts.

reuse_envelope.reason: Reuse controller/worker; qualify only numeric-authoring persistence, not arbitrary authoring.

authority.reason: No new331 corrections, paid runtime, external calls or image/identity changes.

strategy.reason: First test native preservation, then fresh-process output, then failed-proof dependency block.

visual_gate.reason: Actual rejected-control PNG remains FAIL despite technical success.

anticipation.reason: Anticipate broken relative paths, disabled-driver dependencies and false positive visual promotion.

stopping.reason: Complete technical qualification or expose failure; no full sequence rendering of known defects.

versioning.reason: Bind original, recipes, handler bytes, outputs and known dependency hashes.

economics.reason: One serial native job per planned step; record time, no inferred percentage gain.

au_reuse.reason: Fresh reopen not whole-project portable or remote backup; retain all failures.

au_review.reason: Technical output review and frame-visible rejection distinct from Director AV.

control.reason: All four technical/negative-control requirements scoped; no artistic admission.

challenge.cross_discipline_conflicts: Diagnostic CPU rendering may differ from source engine; no pixel replay or art success claim.
challenge.omission_probe: Unpacked textures, disabled drivers, stale recipe and failed-dependency bypass are explicit risks.

method_choice.chosen: Fixed native numeric-authoring handler, save followed by independently launched reopen/render.
method_choice.alternatives: Reject raw331 launcher and arbitrary scripts: bypass admission or transitive pinning. Mock-only is insufficient.
method_choice.discriminating_test: Selected state and dependencies survive new process and actual failed proof blocks next step.

steps.acceptance: Source unchanged, actual native and inventory returned; no missing dependencies.
Fresh process selected state matches; actual image inspected; art rejection remains.
Negative control: MUST NOT dispatch after failed image proof.
